title: lifs-tools/msdeposit pipeline parameters
description: Prepares mass spectrometry studies for MetaboLights deposition (mzML, ISA-Tab, MAF, mzTab-M, mzQC) with an optional sensitive-data path (anonymised mzML only, identifier checks)

input.description: Run sheet: one row per run (resulting mzML) with study, run, assay, sample, format and path.
input.help_text: Columns: study, run, assay, sample, format (vendor_raw|mzml|pwiz_text), path, and optionally vendor, companions, run_index, polarity, deposited_name, raw_id. In sensitive mode run keys must not identify the lab (checked).

assays.description: Assays sheet (CSV): study, assay, technique, polarity, acquisition, column model/type, injection system, measurement type, instrument fallback, protocol keys.

samples.description: Samples sheet (CSV): study, source_name, sample_name and characteristics:<Name>[::source|::accession|::unit], factor:<Name>[...], comment:<Name> columns.

studies.description: Studies YAML: 'defaults' (merged into each study) and 'studies' with title, description, licence, release date, design descriptors, factors, protocols, accession.

contacts.description: Contacts (CSV): study (empty = all studies), first_name, last_name, email, affiliation, address, orcid, roles (';'-separated).

protocols.description: Directory with protocol texts <key>.md (all studies) and <study>/<key>.md; unresolved keys become [[TODO-PROTOCOL:<key>]].

features.description: Reported features (CSV): study, assay, feature, name, level, formula, mz, rt, adduct, charge, database_id, quantifier.

values.description: Reported values (CSV): study, feature, run or study_variable, value, unit (UO term), variation, variation_type (sd|cv_percent|none).

study_variables.description: Study variables (CSV): study, study_variable, description, average_function.

study_variable_members.description: Study variable members (CSV): study, study_variable, sample.

transitions.description: SRM transitions (CSV): study, assay, transition, q1, q3, polarity, feature, collision_energy.

denylist.description: Additional identifier tokens (one per line, or TSV with a 'token' column); never filtered.

allowlist.description: Tokens that are allowed although harvested as identifier candidates.

outdir.description: Public output directory: receives only the upload sets of studies that passed all checks.

private_outdir.description: Private output directory (mappings, check details, denylists, blocked studies, pipeline_info in sensitive mode). Default in standard mode: <outdir>/private. Required in sensitive mode, and neither nested in outdir nor vice versa.

private_launch_dir.description: Sensitive mode with an object-store --private_outdir (s3://...): local private directory that must contain the Nextflow launch and work directories (they hold logs and command history).

mode_options.title: Mode options
mode_options.description: Standard deposition or the sensitive-data preset (docs/design.md §5, §9).

sensitive_data.description: Sensitive-data preset: anonymised mzML only, raw files kept private, identifier scans, leak boundary. Contradicting switches are rejected.

deposit_raw.description: Deposit vendor raw files (directory formats zipped). Default: true (standard), false (sensitive, required).

finalise_mode.description: mzML finalisation. Default: rename (standard), anonymise (sensitive, required).

deposited_naming.description: Deposited mzML names: sanitised original stems or neutral <sample>_<POL>[_<acq>]. Default: original (standard), neutral (sensitive, required).

identifier_scan.description: Identifier denylist and scan of the upload set (S1, S2). Default: false (standard), true (sensitive, required).

mzml_body_rewrite.description: Sensitive mode: replace denylist tokens in spectrum/chromatogram ids, titles and userParams. When false, studies with identifying body text are blocked by S2.

enforce_private_launch.description: Refuse to start unless the launch and work directories are inside private_outdir. Default: true in sensitive mode.

deposit_report.description: Add the public deposit report (FILES/QC/deposit_report.html) to the upload set.

timestamp_policy.description: Acquisition timestamps in mzML and ISA: keep, date only, or drop.

mztab_versions.description: mzTab-M versions to write: 2.0.0-M (default), 2.1.0-M or both comma-separated.

lipid_annotation.description: Annotate feature names with Goslin (and SwissLipids, needs a cache or --allow_network).

swisslipids_cache.description: SwissLipids lookup cache (TSV), read and updated.

allow_network.description: Allow network access for the lipid annotation (SwissLipids). The C7 mzTab-M check always has network (OLS).

accept_vendor_licenses.description: Required to use the ProteoWizard image with vendor readers (https://proteowizard.sourceforge.io/licenses.html).

controlled_value_profile.description: Controlled values accepted by the bundled validator, or the MetabolomicsHub terms.

check_options.title: Check options
check_options.description: Which check results block a study.

fail_on_todo_placeholders.description: Make remaining [[TODO-...]] placeholders and empty required fields (C9) blocking; use for submission-ready runs.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
